description: The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Fiend Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared. Level 3: Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion. Level 5: Fireball, Stinking Cloud. Level 7: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire. Level 9: Geas, Insect Plague.
name: Fiend Spells
